invariants.rationale: The postcondition guarantees the visible lines cover the cursor line: the first visible line is <= the cursor and the last visible line (firstLineShowing + linesShowing - 1) is >= cursorLine.

invariants.expression: cursorLine == firstLineShowing || cursorLine == firstLineShowing + linesShowing - 1 || (cursorLine > firstLineShowing && cursorLine < firstLineShowing + linesShowing - 1)
invariants.rationale: Covers the possibility that cursorLine is within the range of visible lines including the endpoints.
